He hugged the carefully dressed lace Lisa's waist, his hands wandering restlessly on her bare back, whispering explicit flirtatious words. A personality enjoys the physical contact and false obedience bought with money, and is mentally planning how to "enjoy" her later when going to the hotel. The B personality, on the other hand, stands in the abyss of consciousness, watching her every forced smile and every evasive look as ironclad evidence of her "depravity and hypocrisy", and her murderous and tyrannical desires grow wildly.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/aeb0f2ac8114372f8386d6df8a1efaf41460356a.png"][/img][/p][p]"... Here I am," personality B growled in the dark, his fingers trembling with excitement, "you don't want to pretend again! I want to see your most 'real' appearance! Cry, shout, and then... shut up forever!"[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/7e407b0662f67e80dff5e5ff40f090a7be2f4897.png"][/img][/p][p]Late at night, as soon as Lisa returned to the upscale apartment building, she was dragged into the shadows by a tremendous force. The cold towel soaked in medicine tightly covered her mouth and nose. She widened her eyes in horror and saw the attacker's face clearly - it was Chen Feng, who had violently occupied her on the hotel bed at night, causing her pain and fear! But the face in front of me twisted like a demon. Before she could even struggle, her consciousness became blurred.[/p][p]When she woke up, Lisa found herself naked, with her wrists and ankles tightly locked to a cold metal bed by rough iron chains. The basement was filled with a musty and bloody smell. The only bright light came from a dim yellow light bulb above. Chen Feng (with personality B) stood by the bed, his eyes fixed on a piece of meat.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/ed4a8be25a5ff9f07fbaf8d04bbf49f552c18fbd.png"][/img][/p][p]Feng... Feng Ge? "Lisa was scared out of her wits and her voice trembled uncontrollably.[/p][p]"Who the hell is your brother?" Personality B slapped her in the face and made her mouth bleed. "Don't you shout happily when you collect money in the daytime? When I fuck you in the hotel bed, you also pretend to be an orgasm?" He bent down, grabbed her chin with his rough fingers, which was so powerful that he almost crushed her bones. Now, call out to me! Just like you call out to those old men! Call out[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/030bd8144ab2cc1db313e222d56c50538dad34c2.png"][/img][/p][p]Fear and intense pain made Lacelisa burst into tears, struggling in vain with the clanging of iron chains. But this crying and struggle only made B personality more excited. He tore open her clothes, pressed them on, and acted roughly like a beast, without any foreplay, only pure abuse and venting. He insulted her with the dirtiest and most vulgar words, taking her performance in the live broadcast room, obedience on a date, and even her recent experience in a hotel as proof of her "lowliness", torturing her repeatedly with his body and language. The basement echoed with the screams and cries of women and the heavy breathing and cursing of men.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/250671e73b7d8c5411f18c3c18e4be4f71247c25.png"][/img][/p][p]I don't know how long it took, but after venting his animalistic desires, the B personality looked at the woman on the bed who was barely alive and had empty eyes, and that destructive desire rose again. It's so dirty, "he murmured to himself, his eyes becoming unusually cold. He picked up the dagger, without any hesitation, and accurately cut open her throat. Blood gushed out like a fountain, staining the cold sheets red. Lisa's body convulsed violently a few times and completely stopped moving. B personality licked the blood splattered at the corners of his mouth, feeling the warm and sweet smell, revealing a satisfied and twisted smile. He scanned the oversized humanoid garbage bag with the corner of his eye and said, "Can I fit the whole one? I won't have to dismember it again[/p][p]As dawn approached, B personality disappeared. Chen Feng (A personality) woke up on the big bed in his luxurious apartment, feeling sore all over, as if he had fought. He vaguely remembered that he had a crazy time playing with Lisa at the hotel last night, and later he seemed to have had a particularly violent nightmare. He habitually picked up his phone, wanting to watch the live broadcast of Lace Lisa, but came across a local news flash: "A well-known female anchor has mysteriously disappeared, and the police are investigating[/p][p]Tsk, it's really disappointing. notes.title: Boss's wife's rain stains
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/ef62cd429dccc040a9d581cae9f57ed2f78f2122.png"][/img]The 29 year old beauty salon owner, Xiao Jiao, seems to have finally experienced a peaceful and fragrant life. The warm fragrance of rose essential oil permeated the beauty room as she was massaging guests. She caught a glimpse of Zhang Cheng's considerate message on her phone: "Don't be too tired, baby. I'll go pick up the candy later?" A soft smile crept onto her lips. Zhang Cheng's appearance was like a carefully arranged beauty salon, bringing a comfortable atmosphere. He not only cared for her, but also took the initiative to pick up and drop off her four year old daughter Candy. He even remembered his child's mango allergy and favorite strawberry cake without fail.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/352774e6c60f88a632616a08395c8765039f6f5b.png"][/img]When her best friend Lin Wei visited, she looked at the lively Tangtang and Xiaojiao and sincerely praised them: "If Tangtang Dad knew you had met someone as good as Zhang Cheng, he would probably regret it! Did you really hit the jackpot this time?" Xiaojiao sorted out her daughter's backpack, her fingertips light and lively, and her voice filled with tiny starlight: "Hmm, he loves Tangtang..." The cherished sense of security made her believe that she had finally met the right person this time.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/9dbdf2a3eb18e76c0d7ce5a389975c32f6c7ed4a.png"][/img]However, this carefully constructed warmth collapsed with a loud bang on a night when ink was splattered. Xiao Jiao suddenly realized on the way back to the beauty salon that she had forgotten to bring her phone, and found that the door of the salon was partially covered with a faint light. She lightly stepped inside, but was pinned in place by the familiar gasps and teasing coming from the beauty salon deep in the hallway. Through the slightly open door crack, she saw her two bodies entwining with each other on the beauty bed she meticulously wiped every day. Lin Wei gasped and asked, "How about this newly imported instrument at home... does it feel good lying down?" Zhang Cheng rubbed his hand into her hair, his voice sticky and nauseating: "How can the instrument compare to your smooth skin? Hmm?" The world instantly overturned, and Xiao Jiao bit her lower lip tightly, tasting the sweet and fishy taste. Her nails squeezed her palm deeply, and she escaped from this lie nest without looking back.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/c85ba4618de2b5a27a95067dca44c5fbbab191e5.png"][/img]Returning to the cold home, Xiaojiao gently carried the sleeping candy out of the children's room. The child's gentle little body nestled in her arms, with a heart wrenching milk fragrance and unreserved trust. Outside the window, the rainstorm that had been brewing for a long time finally fell, and the big raindrops quickly knocked on the glass, drawing water marks. Mom, why are you crying? "Tangtang reached out her warm little hand in confusion and pressed it against Xiaojiao's cold and moist cheek. Xiaojiao shivered, bent her head and kissed her daughter's finger with force. Her voice was as soft as a feather in a rainstorm, but she tried to keep it steady: "Tangtang was wrong," she held her daughter and looked at the misty rainy night. "Mom didn't cry." She paused, pressing her daughter's little hand closer to her lips, "It's rain."[/p]

notes.title: Heartbeat in Light and Shadow
notes.notes: [p]The clear sea breeze of Jeju Island carries a salty taste, blowing through the filming location of the "Poetry of the Ocean" swimsuit advertisement. 25-year-old emerging director Jiang Yuzhen is known for his strict adherence to visual aesthetics. He scrutinized the twin models Han Xialin and Han Xiaen in front of the camera through the monitor. They have almost the same amazing beauty, and their 18-year-old youth shines in the sun. But Yuzhen quickly captured something different: her younger sister Shane was like a dazzling flame, confident and confident, smiling brightly at the camera, and her body language was bold and powerful; Sister Charlotte, on the other hand, is like a calm lake, with a restrained temperament and subtle melancholy and contemplation hidden in her eyes. Her movements are even more elegant and reserved.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/50414dcf42009b8745531be43c9bc359554afb83.png"][/img][/p][p]During filming breaks, Yuzhen's gaze is always unconsciously drawn to Xia Lin. He saw her sitting alone under a parasol, with a sketchbook spread out on her knees, her fingertips gently tracing the distant waves and rocks, and the morning mist casting a soft glow on her calm silhouette. At that moment, Yuzhen's heart seemed to have been hit by something - this was the soul of his "ocean poem": deep, mysterious, with a hint of imperceptible sadness.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/d99864e42ab82fba501c28b3a792d89891a960b4.png"][/img][/p][p]When officially filming Xia Lin's shot, Yuzhen's requirements were particularly strict. Let your eyes be a little more relaxed, imagine the sea breeze piercing through your body, with a salty loneliness. "His voice came through the walkie talkie, with unquestionable focus. Introverted Xia Lin felt pressure, but miraculously understood his intentions. She tried to restrain her mind and immerse herself in that tranquility. When she lifted her eyes and looked at Yuzhen through the camera, her gaze was like a deep sea, instantly capturing his attention. Yuzhen was shocked by this precise artistic expression, and he had never seen any model understand his abstract requirements so thoroughly. When he was resting, he inexplicably walked towards Charlene. Just now... that feeling was perfect, "Yuzhen spoke awkwardly, his gaze falling on Xia Lin's sketchbook." Are you drawing the sea[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/e3b86f1d137a1f9bef232599166df1c15922db7f.png"][/img][/p][p]Charlotte blushed slightly and gathered the courage to open her notebook, whispering, "Hmm... I think the melancholy of the sea shouldn't just be blue. There are deeper emotions hidden in the shadows of the rocks, just like what your camera wants to capture." She pointed to the varying shades of gray on her artwork.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/c478aaee831373815d22a7c2d6219ee22ac42867.png"][/img][/p][p]Yuzhen's heart skipped a beat. Her insights coincide with her own, even more delicate! The two discussed light and shadow, composition, and emotions. The artistic insights that Charlene is usually shy about expressing, flowed naturally like a spring in front of this talented director. Yuzhen found a long lost, soulful resonance, deeply attracted by the profound artistic perception beneath Charlene's calm exterior. And Xia Lin, also listening attentively and insightful in Yuzhen, felt an unprecedented understanding, and her heart strings quietly stirred.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/28cef77abb523874d382c70164726eaa2ac9ca44.png"][/img][/p][p]Occasionally, lively Xia En would jump over and tease Yu Zhen, imitating her sister's quiet demeanor: "Director, do you think I'm enough of a 'poem of the ocean' like this?" However, Yu Zhen always frowned slightly, feeling that something was wrong - the deliberate imitation lacked Xia Lin's natural soul. This made him even more convinced that what caught his heart was the calm state of 'Shane' (he still mistook his identity).[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/65be048a7844a2815de5e4ef907474d86be0bcd6.png"][/img][/p][p]The shooting was a great success. At the celebration banquet, the bubbles of champagne reflected laughter and joy. After a few drinks, Yuzhen could no longer suppress the excitement in his heart. He found Charmaine (whom he thought was Charmaine) alone watching the night view on the terrace, with a suppressed excitement in his voice: "Charmaine," he called out the wrong name, "I have to tell you... these days, I have been deeply attracted to you. It's not the dazzling you in front of the camera, but the calm you during filming, who seems to understand every idea I have. Your eyes, the light and shadow on your artwork... you have shown me the purest form of art. I have never met someone who understands me like you[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/e271aa8e65bc3814bdc109a3a7f48341bbcf8f4c.png"][/img][/p][p]The blood on Charlene's face instantly faded away. The immense joy and sharp pain tore her apart at the same time. He loves her! It's her soul, Han Xialin! But that affectionate confession kept calling out her sister's name 'Shane' repeatedly! It turns out that the 'calm and perfect Shane' in his eyes is Han Xialin from beginning to end! Tears welled up in his eyes without warning, blurring Yuzhen's shocked face. She couldn't breathe, let alone speak the truth at this moment - was it to expose this cruel misunderstanding, or to break this budding and incredibly precious connection? She suddenly turned around, as if escaping from a beautiful nightmare, her slender figure quickly disappeared into the night and the hustle and bustle of the crowd.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/7fa66c7ab099ac4ff3a759b42a1288641116cdcc.png"][/img][/p][p]Yuzhen froze in place, his outstretched hand stopped in mid air. The affectionate confession still hung in the air, and the immense sadness and resolute escape in "Shane"'s eyes woke him up like a bucket of ice water. Confusion and a strong sense of unease instantly gripped him. He looked at the disappearing figure and realized for the first time with great clarity that the calm figure that made his soul tremble seemed to have never truly belonged to the name 'Shane'. The sea breeze blew with a chill, and he murmured with a hint of panic that he hadn't even noticed: "... Shane?" The night fell silent, leaving only a huge mystery about identity and sincerity, and a heart that suddenly ached due to the wrong name.[/p]

Under the new hot search # Lisa Investiture #, the final dynamic is a silhouette on Iceland's black sand beach, with ankle tattoos covering old scars: a ball of burning lace.[/p]

She tore open her shirt in a moment of weightlessness, her snow-white chest hit the windshield, and the galaxy outside the window exploded into a galaxy of desire - this photo topped the headline of Speed Weekly the next day.[/p][p][/p][p][b]The sacrifice of the championship podium[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/bd7adce8dd7c737c0c46905334c958d2744c3199.png"][/img]In the final of the SEMA modification exhibition, Kane's tank was on the brink of retirement due to Alison's "mistake" in tuning. notes.title: TSilver moon generates its own light
notes.notes: [p]The bonfire reflects a silver glow[/p][p]The background of the virtual live broadcast room is a leaping Miao bonfire, with light and shadow flowing on the 175 centimeter S-shaped curve of Ling'er. The hyper realistic camera captures her tightly: she wears a complex Miao silver crown and collar, her long hair is like a waterfall, her delicate face is gentle and peaceful in the firelight, and her fair and tight skin is flawless. She was wearing a hollowed out Miao costume with an exposed waist, and the totem pattern was vividly depicted in close ups. Her full chest and slender waist formed a charming contrast. With her red lips lightly parted, she softly introduced the ancient symbolism of silver jewelry, her gaze like water, and her fingertips gently caressing the totem on her chest, each frame like a carefully crafted painting.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/4c8aad2c56a2ec1b99c8d4dbe7e3f1c98d962731.png"][/img][/p][p]The spark suddenly breaks[/p][p]Just as she picked up a silver phoenix hairpin and was about to showcase its exquisite craftsmanship, the background of the virtual bonfire suddenly flickered violently, stuttered, and finally fell into a dazzling digital snowflake and darkness. The live broadcast room was instantly silent, leaving only the silhouette of Ling'er in shock. In a close-up shot, her long eyelashes trembled with surprise, her red lips slightly parted, and her soft eyes reflected a faulty blue light. The meticulously crafted immersive night in the Miao region was mercilessly interrupted by a cold technological malfunction.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/81b8ce5e53648f27057b4e288823deca1259bf1c.png"][/img][/p][p]Silver moon generates its own light[/p][p]Ling'er did not panic. After two seconds of silence, she suddenly turned to the camera and burst into a smile warmer than a campfire. She elegantly took off the brightest round of silver moon headdress on her head and held it close to the camera with both hands. Super realistic close-up focus: Silver Moon shines brightly in her fair palm, clearly reflecting her peaceful eyes. Look, "her voice remained soft but penetrating," the true light is in our own hands, in the wisdom of our ancestors. "The dark background of the malfunction made this pure silver moon and her confident smile the only and shocking light source, instantly overwhelming the live broadcast room with astonishment and gifts.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/2ee3a7df49cb8c0e6206350c47ca4ab975003862.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Ice Blade Reflects Summer Solstice: Sakura's Secret Spring of Fuji

Ninnomura's' Water of Longevity 'can cleanse the impurities of flesh and blood, and also nourish the surging killing intent. On the summer solstice, the sunlight pierced through the gaps in the forest, and the tip of Sakura's knife lifted water droplets, reflecting the hundred coins that had fallen from the bottom of the pool - they were offerings for fools to pray for good luck, and also evidence of the crime of prey being lost.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45665954/7e8306fa1a0e58c5520bb5998b903c4e5a9e9d51.png"][/img][/p]
